title: Senior IT Specialist (Robotic Process Automation and AI)

requirements.text: You must be a U.S. Citizen or National to apply for this position.
You will be subject to a background and suitability investigation.
Males born after December 31, 1959, must be registered or exempt from Selective Service
requirements.evidence: Selective Service: Males born after December 31, 1959, must be registered or exempt from Selective Service

requirements.text: If you are selected for this position, the documentation that you present for purposes of completing the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) form I-9 will be verified through the DHS "E-Verify" System.
requirements.evidence: One-year probationary period may be required.
